rtsCodes.EVENT: Once an item receives a Return to Sender (RTS) event, the following description will be displayed.
rtsCodes.EVENT_CODE: Once an item receives a Return to Sender (RTS) event, the following description will be displayed.
rtsCodes.DESCRIPTION: Once an item receives a Return to Sender (RTS) event, the following description will be displayed.
A = Authorized Return
B = Anticipated Return
R = RTS
Blank = No return flag

rtsCodes.EVENT: If the return flag is ON, use RTS events instead of standard events.
If event code 1496 (Delivered) occurs, display the RTS event description instead of the standard “Delivered” description.
